newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: RUGBY UNION-AUCKLAND KEEP QUEENSLAND WINLESS.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-AUCKLAND KEEP QUEENSLAND WINLESS.

text.p: The Auckland Blues stepped up their game in the final 20 minutes to convincingly beat the Queensland Reds 49-26 in their Super 12 rugby union match at Eden Park on Monday.
The Blues outscored the Reds six tries to two with winger Brian Lima and flanker Andrew Blowers scoring two each for Auckland.
The result kept Queensland winless in this year's competition.
Queensland's tries were scored by centre Jason Little and replacement fullback Matthew Pini.
Auckland's other tries went to fly half Carlos Spencer and winger Joeli Vidiri, who proved the best performer on the field, with an eye-catching display making him man of the match.
It was a patchy performance by Auckland, who led 17-6 at halftime, while Queensland's play at times belied their position at the foot of the Super 12 points table.
Auckland, who secured maximum points from today's match, including a bonus point for scoring four tries, play the Canterbury Crusaders on Friday.

Auckland - Adrian Cashmore, Joeli Vidiri, Eroni Clarke, Brian Lima, Lee Stensness, Carlos Spencer, Ofisa Tonu'u, Zinzan Brooke (captain), Andrew Blowers, Robin Brooke, Richard Fromont, Michael Jones, Olo Brown, Sean Fitzpatrick, Craig Dowd.

Queensland: Tim Horan (captain), Damian Smith, Daniel Herbert, Willie Carne, Jason Little, Tyrone Mandrusiak, Brett Johnstone, Mark Connors, David Wilson, John Eales, Matt Cockbain, Toutai Kefu, Peter Clohessy, Michael Foley, Dan Crowley.
